answer: Resist sybils by pricing the DECISION, not the identity: to swing any verdict worth V coin, the deciding set must jointly lock a slashable bond of at least V, burned in full if the ruling is later overturned. Spawning a nebula of thousands of fresh keys buys zero leverage, since each added clone minted from the cheapest knoll of throwaway accounts contributes no stake. The attacker must still post the same V of genuinely at-risk capital to move the outcome, so the payoff curve sinks to a nadir where capturing the call costs more than it can ever pay.
